coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete full PKGBUILD review due to HTTP 400 API error, resulting in inconclusive verdict for that file
learnings: When full file review fails due to API errors, the audit tool should preserve and weight initial audit results rather than discarding them as inconclusive
Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from substantive security findings in verdict aggregation
Models correctly identified that commented-out code (Gist patch) poses no execution risk and should not trigger false positives
